**判「该不该派活」用它**：labels 是当前全部标签，加一个无关标签也会让: **Use this to decide whether to act on it**: labels is the full current set, so adding even an unrelated label will make it include "claude"
**处理完摘掉触发标签**，就不会被同一个 Issue 反复触发: **Remove the trigger label once handled**, so the same issue does not keep re-triggering
**新文件里的行号**（diff 右侧）。评论被删掉的行请用「原文件行号」: **The line number in the new file** (right side of the diff). For a deleted line, use "Old file line number" instead
**翻页看它,别看本页条数**——正好 50 条并不代表翻完了: **Use this to decide whether to page further, not the count on this page** — exactly 50 results does not mean you have seen them all
**翻页看它，别看本页条数**——正好 50 条并不代表翻完了: **Use this to decide whether to page further, not the count on this page** — exactly 50 results does not mean you have seen them all
**防自触发靠它**，机器人回复也是评论: **Used to prevent self-triggering** — a bot's own reply is also a comment
**防自触发靠它**：机器人回复也是评论，工作流里务必把机器人账号滤掉，否则无限: **Used to prevent self-triggering**: a bot's own reply is also a comment, so the workflow must filter out the bot account or it will loop forever
CI 变量键值对（如 {\"DEPLOY_ENV\":\"staging\"}）: CI variable key-value pairs (e.g. {"DEPLOY_ENV":"staging"}); key names are defined by .gitlab-ci.yml
GitLab 应答 JSON，形状随接口而变，由官方 API 文档定义: The GitLab response JSON, whose shape varies by endpoint as defined in the official API docs
GitLab 报的**全部**条数（不是本页）。0 = 上游没给这个头（超大结果: The **total** count reported by GitLab (not just this page). 0 = upstream did not provide this header (omitted for very large result sets)
Issue 的正文。**要把 Issue 内容交给下游（如让 agent 照着做: The issue body. **This is what you pass downstream when handing off the issue content (e.g. for an agent to act on)** — the title is often just one line
Issue/MR 的标题；代码命中时是文件名: The issue/MR title; the file name for a code hit
MR 改动里的路径，用「MR 改动」出参的 path: The path from the MR changes; use the `path` output from "MR changes"
RFC3339；留空不限: RFC3339; leave blank for no limit
branch 不存在时以它为起点新建（提 MR 的常用流）；留空不新建: If branch does not exist, create it starting from here (a common flow before opening an MR); leave blank to not create one
group/name 形态，其他操作的 project 字段用它: In group/name form; used for the project field in other operations
path 形态逗号分隔（如 backend/server,infra/deplo: Comma-separated paths (e.g. backend/server,infra/deploy). **Setting this is what starts the event source**: new commits/new MRs/merges/new issues/pipeline failures will trigger the workflow (polling, about 1 minute of delay; for zero delay, point a GitLab webhook at the platform's webhook trigger instead)
poll = 轮询 Events API / webhook = GitLab: poll = polling the Events API / webhook = pushed by GitLab. **This determines the shape of `raw`**
true = 至少一个文件的 diff 没给全，别据此下「改动很小」的结论: true = at least one file's diff was not given in full; do not conclude "the change is small" from this
「评论 Issue」的出参 note_id: The note_id output from "Comment on issue"
上游原始载荷。**两条路的形状不一样**：source=poll 时是 Even: The raw upstream payload. **The shape differs between the two paths**: when source=poll it is an Events API event object, when source=webhook it is the hook request body. To drill into `raw` you must check `source` first, otherwise changing the deployment method will silently get you nothing — prefer the normalized fields above instead
个人访问令牌（用户头像 → Preferences → Access Token: A personal access token (avatar -> Preferences -> Access Tokens), with at least the api scope; it is recommended to create a dedicated bot-account token with just the scopes you need
仓库内路径，如 config/app.yaml: Path within the repository, e.g. config/app.yaml
代码命中的上下文，或 Issue/MR 的正文开头: The surrounding context for a code hit, or the start of the body for an issue/MR hit
以 / 开头、不带 /api/v4 前缀，如 /projects/42/rele: Starts with /, without the /api/v4 prefix, e.g. /projects/42/releases; fill in the actual value wherever :id appears
关键词；代码搜索支持 GitLab 的高级语法（如 filename:*.go）: The keyword; code search supports GitLab's advanced syntax (e.g. filename:*.go)
列出有权限的项目（可按名字搜）: Lists the projects you have access to (optionally searchable by name)
创建 Issue（告警落单：监控发现问题 → 自动开单跟踪）: Creates an issue (for turning an alert into a ticket: monitoring finds a problem -> automatically open a ticket to track it)
取一个 MR 改了哪些文件、每个文件的 diff。**让 agent revie: Gets which files an MR changed and each file's diff. **This is what you use to have an agent review an MR**
取一个 job 的日志尾部（失败排查：拿去给 LLM 总结失败原因再发群）: Gets the tail of a job's log (for debugging failures: feed it to an LLM to summarize the failure reason and post it to chat)
合并一个 MR（未过 CI / 有冲突时 GitLab 会拒绝，报错里说明原因）: Merges an MR (GitLab will reject it if CI has not passed or there are conflicts, with the reason in the error)
在 MR 下留一条评论（机器人报告审查结果/检查清单的落点）: Leaves a comment on an MR (where a bot posts review results or a checklist)
在 MR 的某个文件某一行上开一条评论线程——review 意见要落到具体那一行: Opens a comment thread on a specific line of a specific file in an MR — a review comment is only useful when it lands on that exact line
在指定分支起一条流水线，可带 CI 变量（定时构建/发布流程的起点）: Starts a pipeline on a given branch, optionally with CI variables (the starting point for scheduled builds or release flows)
平台代收 webhook 用：GitLab 项目 Settings→Webhoo: For the platform to receive webhooks on your behalf: the Secret token set in the GitLab project's Settings -> Webhooks. Only accepted if both sides match (prevents forgery). Leave blank if not using webhooks
打标签的人（轮询路径取不到，为空）: Who applied the label (empty when fetched via polling, as it is not available there)
把 GitLab 接进工作流：读写仓库文件、建/评/合 MR、开 Issue、查: Brings GitLab into workflows: read and write repository files, create/comment on/merge MRs, open issues, check pipelines and failure logs, and trigger builds.
把内容提交到仓库（文件不存在则创建，存在则覆盖，自动判断）。多文件一次提交走「通: Commits content to the repository (creates the file if it does not exist, overwrites it if it does, detected automatically). For committing multiple files at once, use the commits endpoint via "Generic call"
拿它当闸：只处理打了某个标签的 Issue，比「谁建的都跑」安全得多: Use this as a gate: only handling issues with a specific label is much safer than acting on anything created
按名字/路径模糊搜；留空列全部: Fuzzy search by name/path; leave blank to list all
接「Job 列表」「Job 日志」排障: Chain into "Job list" / "Job log" to debug
搜代码 / Issue / MR / 提交。留空项目 = 全实例搜（agent: Searches code / issues / MRs / commits. Leave the project blank to search the whole instance (the most direct way for an agent to find "where is this function used")
改标题/正文、加减标签、关闭或重开、转草稿。只填要改的，其余不动: Change the title/description, add or remove labels, close or reopen, or convert to draft. Only fill in what you want to change; everything else is left as is
改标题/正文、加减标签、指派、关闭或重开。只填要改的，其余不动: Change the title/description, add or remove labels, assign, close or reopen. Only fill in what you want to change; everything else is left as is
数字 ID 或路径（如 backend/server，即仓库地址里域名后那段）: A numeric ID or path (e.g. backend/server, i.e. the part of the repository URL after the domain)
更新已有的一条评论。**长任务应该先回一条「处理中…」、跑完更新同一条**——既: Updates an existing comment. **For a long-running task, post a "working on it…" comment first and update that same one when done** — this avoids flooding the thread and avoids one more chance of a "comment triggers workflow" loop
最近的流水线与状态（CI 监控：定时查 → failed 触发告警）: Recent pipelines and their status (for CI monitoring: poll on a schedule -> a failed status triggers an alert)
某分支最近的提交（变更监控：定时查 → 有新提交触发下游）: Recent commits on a branch (for change monitoring: poll on a schedule -> a new commit triggers downstream steps)
用户名；留空 = 不改: Username; leave blank to leave unchanged
留空 = 全实例搜。**大实例上全局搜代码可能很慢**，能限定就限定: Leave blank to search the whole instance. **Searching code instance-wide can be slow on large instances**, so scope it to a project when you can
留空用默认分支: Leave blank to use the default branch
直调任意 GitLab REST v4 接口（token 由插件带上）。type: Calls any GitLab REST v4 endpoint directly (the plugin attaches the token). Anything not covered by a typed operation goes through here; follow the official API docs for the path, e.g. /projects/:id/releases
看一条流水线里各 job 的状态（找出挂了哪个）: Checks the status of each job in a pipeline (to find which one failed)
等流水线过了再合: Merge only after the pipeline succeeds
给 MR 投一个批准票。**注意这是以凭证那个账号的身份批的**——别让它替人做: Casts an approval vote on an MR. **Note this approves as the credential's own account** — do not let it make the decision on someone else's behalf
自建实例填根地址（如 https://git.example.com）；留空 =: For a self-hosted instance, enter its root URL (e.g. https://git.example.com); leave blank for gitlab.com
评论被删除的行时填这个，同时把「行号」留空: Fill this in when commenting on a deleted line, and leave "Line number" blank
请求体 JSON，键名照 GitLab API 文档；GET 时作为 query: The request body as JSON, with key names following the GitLab API docs; used as query parameters for GET
读仓库里一个文件的内容（配置/清单/文档都常用）: Reads the content of a file in the repository (commonly used for config/manifests/docs)
调 /user 验证 token 有效，并显示这个 token 是谁的: Calls /user to verify the token is valid, and shows whose token it is
超出截断。默认 20000——一个几万行的迁移 diff 会把下游的上下文占满: Truncated beyond this. Defaults to 20000 — a tens-of-thousands-of-lines migration diff would otherwise fill up a downstream step's whole context
跨项目搜索时用它分辨命中在哪个仓库: Used to tell which repository a hit came from when searching across projects
这次说了什么——派活时把它当指令: What was said this time — treat it as the instruction when deciding what to do
项目内编号（!42 的 42），其他 MR 操作认它: The number within the project (the 42 in !42); other MR operations identify it by this
